body_excerpt: Working with geographic data can involve a surprisingly high barrier to entry. GeoLibre is one such system, and it runs directly in a web browser. Students need to learn not only how to generate answers, but how to question them, verify them, and recognize when a polished response reflects fluency rather than understanding. In that sense, AI literacy should be taught less as a technical skill and more as a reflective discipline. The goal is not to ban AI from learning.
